n_try1.text: Decided 16 Nov (D-399, D-402): Try TLM has its own icon in the navigation and keeps the green button in the top bar. Its parts are tabs, like a project: Chat, Agents, Prompts, Folders, Skills, Schedules, Memory, Connectors, Files. LibreChat's code is brought in, then each screen is rebuilt on the kit to its board. Session text is kept where only the person can read it. Both prompt libraries stay.
